g.data-exception-reason: Explicit Index dot alternatives sample shared continuous contours near2mm pitch using1.2mm design circles. Internal book fold and tool-section boundaries reuse existing junction dots; pairs closer than1.5mm are omitted. Pencil graphite patch uses perimeter plus clipped interior samples within the same master. These alternatives preserve feature intent but not exact continuous stroke extent; no physical dot correspondence assumed.

g.data-design-reason: Reuse exact continuous geometry. Book pages share one lower grey surface beneath higher outer boundary and central fold. Pencil and crayon receive lower body surfaces beneath existing higher contours and section boundaries; the pencil graphite tip remains a higher solid patch. No extra levels, page textures or natural-colour meanings. This allows surface exploration and boundary tracing while keeping geometry compatible with earlier profiles.
